prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / full painterly repaint of Image 1.
IMAGE ROLES:
1 = EDIT TARGET: the five adult companions' casual dinner scene. Preserve its composition, five identities, casual clothes, left-to-right order, three seated women/two standing men, dining actions and warm-lamp/cold-snow-night lighting.
2 = STYLE ONLY, project's approved full-figure block-painting reference: observe connected opaque forms, brush scale, hard shadow planes and selective completion.
3 = STYLE ONLY, approved detail reference: observe painted skin/eyes, layered cloth folds, broad shape edges and visible overpainting.
4 = STYLE ONLY, one of the project's nine approved fusion references: observe chromatic-gray layered painting, quiet broad clothing planes, expressive faces and selective weight-varying drawn lines.
5 = HAIR TECHNIQUE ONLY, current selected hair reference: coherent flowing broad/narrow locks, clean continuous midtones, grouped long shadows and broad highlight ribbons. Borrow no hairstyle, costume, weapon, halo, pose or background from images 2–5. Never copy their text/signatures/watermarks.

The goal is a decisive repaint in ONE unified project-default Japanese anime block-painting style across all FIVE PEOPLE AND THE ROOM. Reconstruct the forms in opaque painted shapes; preserve the target's scene rather than tracing its clean line drawing and applying a texture layer.

OVERALL: hand-painted Japanese anime illustration, opaque layered color blocks, firm light-shadow boundaries and visible directional strokes. Combine coherent large forms and quiet color fields with locally dense, structured smaller planes. Vary stroke length, width and density; retain selected overlaps and dry-brush marks where they describe form.
HAIR: coherent broad and narrow ribbon-like locks with continuous clean base colors and midtones. Long grouped shadows describe overlap and turning; broad luminous bands follow each curved lock with restrained soft transitions. Clear tapered contours and selective separation lines follow growth with varied line weight and deliberate endings. Keep lock volume intact. Avoid dirty gray speckles, scratchy white streaks, flaky overpainting, random small color patches and jagged triangles throughout hair.
CLOTH: readable weight, tension and layered construction. Join long fold planes, short angular strokes and continuous main shadow groups. Keep the casual knits and shirts as large soft fabric shapes with just a few principal fold accents, not dense zigzag weave or hundreds of wrinkles. Dark cloth retains several readable chromatic-gray values. Density follows structure.
FACE AND SKIN: expressive anime eyes with defined lids, layered iris colors and a few unequal highlights; gaze and features suit each character. Economical nose and mouth. Faces more resolved than clothing, with calm warm skin shapes, selected soft transitions, fringe shadows and clear neck/shoulder cast shadows. No uniform blush or polished nose-tip shine. All five faces share the same stylization and painting treatment.
LINES AND EDGES: selective hand-drawn contours vary in weight, color and continuity around eyes, hair tips, fingers, collars and overlaps. Some lines disappear under paint or merge with adjacent colors. Cloth is primarily formed by painted boundaries. Alternate firm edges and a few soft/lost edges; local hatching only where useful. Keep hands and props structurally readable.
COLOR AND MATERIAL: coherent muted/chromatic-gray base with concentrated vivid accents; warm/cool overpainting follows form and lamp/window light, not merely black/white shading. Skin soft, cloth matte, metal/ceramic with just selected reflections. Resolve focal faces and key hand actions, leave secondary surfaces economical.
ENVIRONMENT AND FOOD use the SAME brush language: broad warm wood planes with a few grain strokes, brickwork grouped into quiet shadow masses, snowy window city simplified into a few blue silhouettes, bread and stew built from a few opaque painted shapes. No photographic bokeh, overly crisp decorative clutter or different rendering engine for props. The amber lamp and cool blue window shadows should unify the entire image.

TARGET DETAILS TO PRESERVE: WU left has silver-white high ponytail, visibly exposed forehead, cyan eyes, blue bow/black rose, ordinary round sunglasses on head, charcoal knit casual top and a playful small fang smile. CHANGWUYU standing left-center is a MALE elf with silver-gray low bun/sidelocks, pointed ears, golden eyes, thin round spectacles, plum cardigan and gray crew-neck shirt, pouring tea. BAITA center has deep brown waves, green beret, oatmeal knit/moss-green apron dress, green eye and gold clips. Correct her fringe orientation: thick opaque hair COMPLETELY covers the eye on the VIEWER'S RIGHT side of her face; show only the eye on VIEWER'S LEFT, with the two gold clips on that exposed-eye side. HEIXIANG standing right-center has dark brown skin, amber eyes, stitched cheek scar, entirely BLACK swept-back hair, proportionate adult head/neck/broad shoulders/arms, burnt-orange shirt and charcoal apron, serving stew. XINGYUE right has pale-blonde braid, gold eyes, WHITE crescent clip, cream blouse/teal cardigan, holding a bowl.

Keep ONE continuous table, one pot with its base resting on the table, tea pouring into a real cup and a plausible ladle grip toward the waiting bowl. Preserve natural adult anatomy; hands economically shaped with clearly attached wrists and believable grips. No extra people, extra fingers, floating objects or costume changes. Retain the target's warm meal conversation, varied sitting/standing heights and connected eye-lines. Full-bleed wide landscape composition, no white background, panel dividers, text, border, signature, watermark or UI.
observations: Opaque painted planes and shared brush treatment applied to characters, tabletop and background; five casual outfits and sitting/standing composition preserved. Baita's eye-covering side remains opposite the current identity specification; no further automatic iteration.
verification: Generated artwork viewed only; no tests, browser acceptance, build, game-asset replacement or submission.
